title: Affine tensor pullback comparison of complexes
statement: Let S be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], C a cochain complex of quasi-coherent O_S-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] [pqf-def-coherent], A=Gamma(S,top), and B any commutative A-algebra. Assume the associated-sheaf functor on B-modules is additive, so it acts termwise on complexes. Write P for C evaluated at the top open. There is an isomorphism of cochain complexes on Spec B between the associated-sheaf complex of the ordinary scalar extension B tensor_A P and the pullback of C along Spec B -> Spec A -> S, where the latter map is S.isoSpec.inv. The isomorphism commutes with every differential. No homology vanishing, flatness or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 01IB and 01I9; affine equivalence and affine pullback.

proof.text: Let h be the top affine open of S and F=restrictFunctor h.fromSpec. The proved source sectionsRestrictFromSpecLinearEquiv gives each component of F followed by moduleSpecGamma isomorphic to evaluation at top. Its explicit formula is restriction of sections followed by restrictAppIso. Hom.app_presheaf_map proves naturality, hence NatIso.ofComponents gives this comparison and mapHomologicalComplexCompIso applies it to C.

Each term of Q=F(C) is quasi-coherent because restriction along an open immersion preserves the local presentations defining quasi-coherence. The affine counit (Q.X n).fromTildeGamma is therefore an isomorphism. fromTildeGammaNatTrans.naturality gives compatibility with the differential. HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents assembles these isomorphisms into tilde(Gamma(Q)) isomorphic to Q.

Replace F by pullback h.fromSpec using restrictFunctorIsoPullback. The proved source tildePullbackIso gives the natural scalar-extension comparison over Spec A and Spec B; mapHomologicalComplexCompIso transfers it to complexes. Pull back the preceding complex isomorphism along Spec B -> Spec A and compose. pullbackComp identifies the two successive pullbacks, and IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top identifies h.fromSpec with S.isoSpec.inv, giving the specified result.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_tensor_pullback_complex_comparison (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine S]
    (C : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ)
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra Γ(S, ⊤) B]
    [(tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of B)).Additive] :
    Nonempty (
      ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of B)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap Γ(S, ⊤) B)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((SheafOfModules.evaluation (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (.op ⊤) :
            S.Modules ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C)) ≅
      (((Modules.pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(S, ⊤) B)) ≫
          S.isoSpec.inv)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C))
